name: agent-router-mcp
description: Local stdio MCP server that routes subtasks across 17 coding CLI harnesses (Claude Code, Codex, Gemini, OpenCode, and more) with plan validation, git worktree isolation, and a Settings UI.
author: nazavod777

scripts.build: node -e "import('fs').then(f=>f.rmSync('dist',{recursive:true,force:true}))" && tsc && node -e "import('fs').then(f=>{f.mkdirSync('dist/settings-ui',{recursive:true}); if(f.existsSync('src/settings-ui/app.html')) f.copyFileSync('src/settings-ui/app.html','dist/settings-ui/app.html'); for(const b of ['main','mcp']) if(f.existsSync('dist/cli/'+b+'.js')) f.chmodSync('dist/cli/'+b+'.js',0o755);})"
scripts.prepublishOnly: npm run build && npm run typecheck && npm test
